```{r}
library(data.table)
hmdb <- fread('hmdb_output.csv')
```

```{r}
data <- unique(hmdb$monisotopic_molecular_weight)
data <- data[!is.na(data)]

min_val <- floor(min(data))
max_val <- ceiling(max(data))
breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, by = 0.2)

freq_table <- table(cut(data, breaks = breaks, right = FALSE))
result <- data.frame(
  Interval = names(freq_table),
  Frequency = as.numeric(freq_table),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
result <- result[result$Frequency>0,]
table(result$Frequency)

breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, by = 0.01)

freq_table <- table(cut(data, breaks = breaks, right = FALSE))
result <- data.frame(
  Interval = names(freq_table),
  Frequency = as.numeric(freq_table),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
result <- result[result$Frequency>0,]
table(result$Frequency)
```
